svg.text: DEFAULT FIELD FILLS ITS PARENT; WIDTH IS CALLER-SET.
W0 IS THE MEASURED DEMO, NOT A FIXED COMPONENT WIDTH.
PANEL WIDTH FITS ITS ROWS AND THE TRIGGER MINIMUM.
CONTENT MODE USES A 200 PX FLOOR; BOTH CAP TO MW.
ACTIVE ROW AND SELECTED CHECK ARE INDEPENDENT.
CHECK SLOT IS RESERVED EVEN WHEN UNSELECTED.
SEARCH AND FOOTER ARE OPTIONAL PINNED REGIONS.
ONLY THE LIST SCROLLS; N ROWS SET THE SHORT HEIGHT.
NESTED PANELS OPEN BESIDE THEIR PARENT ROW.
BASE POSITIONING MAY FLIP OR SHIFT AT COLLISIONS.
SIZE FLOWS FROM ROOT TO TRIGGER AND ALL OPTIONS.
XS IS FIXED; SM / MD ROWS HAVE MINIMUM HEIGHTS.
ENVELOPE = MAXIMUM OF TWO SHADOW LAYERS.
NOMINAL BLUR EXTENT; CSS HAS NO HARD SHADOW EDGE.
SCALE 1:1 · DEFAULT SM · N = 7 · W0 REFERENCE
PANEL W MAY EXCEED THE TRIGGER FOR LONG ROWS.
NO SEARCH / FOOTER IN THIS DEFAULT PLAN.
S2 · I1 · S3 · FLEX · S3 · I2 · S2
NO LEADING ICON → OMIT I1 AND ITS S3.
END SLOT CAN REPLACE I2; INDICATOR=FALSE OMITS IT.
SINGLE AND MULTIPLE BOTH USE A TRAILING CHECK.
SEARCH PAD-X S4; FOOTER INSET / GAP S1.
PROPORTIONAL SCHEMATIC · VERTICAL SEPARATION NOT TO SCALE
SCROLLBAR OVERLAYS LIST; DOES NOT TAKE ROW WIDTH.
BOXED: S4 PAD-X; PLAIN: NO BORDER / PAD, GAP = 6.
SORT ICON-ONLY: SQUARE H1. TEXT SORT: HUG WIDTH.
NESTED: RIGHT / START; S6 GAP, S7 ALIGN OFFSET.
PARENT: ALIGN END IF TRIGGER IS ROW-END, ELSE START.
NO ITEM-OVER-TRIGGER ALIGNMENT IN THIS SELECT.
MW / MH ARE AVAILABLE SPACE; COLLISIONS MAY FLIP.
V1 IS NOT EXPLICITLY SET BY THIS WRAPPER.
Nine registry modules: root, context, shared, utils, trigger, content, sub, item, variants.
Scroll Area / Input / Button / CheckMark + globals; all size and width branches reviewed.
